scenes.heading: Handling a brand that wants to pay in free product instead of cash

sents.d: Handling a brand that wants to pay in free product instead of cash
Product-only deals can be worth it early on -- knowing when to say no matters more later.

Early on, with little portfolio to show, a product-only deal from a brand you'd genuinely use can be a reasonable trade for the content and portfolio piece, especially if the product has real retail value.

Once you have a track record and real rates, consistently accepting product-only offers from brands that can clearly afford to pay undercuts your own market rate and makes it harder to raise prices with everyone else.
A simple rule some creators use: product-only is fine for products worth a meaningful amount, from brands you'd want in your portfolio, but not as a default arrangement once you're established.

take: Accept product-only deals rarely, and not once you're established.
